cross_reference_notes: All three editions are versions of the Zhang Zhung Snyan Rgyud (象雄耳传), a Bon Dzogchen transmission cycle.
W1CZ1000 (662pp) is the most compact; a compendium (གསུང་པོད) with ~21 distinct titled sub-texts.
W4CZ332378 (1111pp, Derge) includes a structural catalog near p.1050 listing: Rigpa Tantra (33 ch.), First Rigpa Tantra (21 ch.), Fifty/Thirty/Twenty Tantras, Empowerment rituals, Mantra chapter.
W00EGS1016835 (1508pp, Ume) is the most extensive; contains explicit chapter markers (ལེའུ) and a completion marker (རྫོགས་སོ) at p.939.
Common structural elements across editions: Guru Yoga, Bardo teachings, Lineage prayers, Dzogchen view exposition, Five Wisdoms, Empowerment rituals.
OCR quality is poor across all editions due to cursive scripts and aged manuscripts; section boundaries are approximate.
